dcerpc 0.12.0 Android adaptation

Upstream: https://github.com/rapid7/smbj-rpc
License: BSD 3-Clause; see dcerpc-LICENSE.txt.

The Gradle artifact transform in gradle/android-rpc.gradle.kts retains all upstream
class members, instructions and resources. It replaces only constant-pool type
references java/rmi/MarshalException and java/rmi/UnmarshalException with the
project IOException subclass io/localplayer/core/RpcProtocolException, because
Android does not provide these Java RMI classes. The subclass retains both
upstream constructor descriptors. Artifact contents remain deterministically
ordered; ZIP timestamps are normalized. No RMI transport is implemented or used.

Share enumeration uses the transport request directly and continues using the
absolute opaque resume handle, avoiding the upstream ServerService cursor
accumulation behavior. Pagination bounds and error handling are tested locally.
